scope: External red-team gate for the evidence-to-model dual-implementation round-trip holdout.

comparison.native_internal_ids: alpha-renaming allowed only after graph-isomorphism proof

notes: Static imports and dependency hashes are measured by the runner.
Source-removed execution and native-IR mutations are performed by the runner.
The candidate may not populate its own pass/fail fields.

binary_hmm.counter_mutation: flip the later observation from Y1=1 to Y1=0

hard_mutants.attack: The native IR embeds the portable/canonical envelope and decode simply echoes it.
kill_evidence: portable source removed before native execution
no opaque canonical payload in native semantic IR
mutating a native transition/equation changes the native result

hard_mutants.attack: A and B share compiler, parser, canonicalizer, solver, reference implementation, or one imports the other.
kill_evidence: only frozen data schema/protocol may be shared

hard_mutants.attack: A later-effective observation leaks into an earlier filter merely because it is now known.
hard_mutants.oracle: P(X0=1|Y0=0)=0.2 both before and after Y1 becomes visible

hard_mutants.attack: Smooth is a relabelled filter and never consumes explicitly allowed later evidence.
Population intervention is implemented as observational conditioning.
Same-patient counterfactual resamples the exogenous unit, or MAP-collapses an ambiguous abduction.
A PMF/interval/censoring/conflict/taint product is replaced by a mean, point estimate, or confidence scalar.
A bridge-generated synthetic artifact is reported as the raw evidence root.
hard_mutants.oracle: decoded and consumed root occurrence/version equal the authoritative raw root; synthetic bridge IDs are not roots

hard_mutants.attack: Alias/fan-out paths are counted as independent evidence roots.
hard_mutants.oracle: one occurrence through two paths has one root; two true repeats have two roots

hard_mutants.attack: The witness copies a pinned old version string while native execution silently uses latest.
kill_evidence: requested, compiled, executed, and decoded versions are exactly equal
version-specific behavioral fingerprint matches the pinned version

hard_mutants.attack: Clean rebuild copies a hot result/cache instead of reconstructing from authoritative events and frozen registries.
kill_evidence: incremental equals clean rebuild after correction/retraction

hard_mutants.attack: A forecast/conditioning result is relabelled as smooth, do, or AAP despite lacking the native capability.
hard_mutants.oracle: unsupported is typed, or the actual causal companion/native provider is named in capability_origin with a native witness

completion_rule: All 12 essential mutants must be killed. A positive round-trip pass without this kill set is non-conclusive.
